name: SurvivalChess
tagline: A timed chess puzzle: move marked pieces off doomed squares using chess moves, plus two invented pieces.
problem: The team wanted a fast, replayable game built on rules players already know.
solution: Each endless round marks pieces for destruction; the player has limited time to move them to safety on a small board, with new Stag and Trident pieces adding movement options.
demo_moment: Team-described: rescue pieces under a countdown across rounds.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Grew from a team member's earlier chess-arrangement game.

lessons: Familiar rules plus a timer make a game judges understand in seconds.
